### 4. Address Mapping

[Offset / Index / Tag 的位数计算 → §02.3 Cache Geometry](#sec-c224-q2-cache-geometry)

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 155" role="img" aria-label="Generic address bit layout from most significant to least significant: Tag A minus i minus o bits, Index i bits, Offset o bits.">
<title>Address Bit Fields · Tag | Index | Offset</title>
<text x="14" y="17" font-size="13" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">MSB · High Bits</text>
<text x="884" y="17" font-size="13" text-anchor="end" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">LSB · Low Bits</text>
<rect x="14" y="28" width="470" height="76" rx="7" fill="var(--nodal-svg-accent-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="491" y="28" width="195" height="76" rx="7" fill="var(--nodal-svg-success-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-success)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="693" y="28" width="193" height="76" rx="7" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">
  <text x="249" y="61" font-size="23" font-weight="700">Tag</text><text x="249" y="85" font-size="16">A − i − o bits</text>
  <text x="588.5" y="61" font-size="23" font-weight="700">Index</text><text x="588.5" y="85" font-size="16">i bits</text>
  <text x="789.5" y="61" font-size="23" font-weight="700">Offset</text><text x="789.5" y="85" font-size="16">o bits</text>
</g>
<path d="M491 111 V123 H886 V111" fill="none" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-muted)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
<text x="688.5" y="145" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">Lowest i + o bits → Index + Offset</text>

```

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">A = Address Width (bits) · i = Index Bits · o = Offset Bits · B = Line Bytes · S = Number of Sets · Tag = Memory Block identifier</small>

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Offset}&=\text{Address}\bmod B\\
\text{Set Index}&=\left\lfloor\frac{\text{Address}}{B}\right\rfloor\bmod S\\
\text{Tag}&=\left\lfloor\frac{\text{Address}}{B\cdot S}\right\rfloor
\end{aligned}
$$

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">Example: A = 32, i = 6, o = 6 → Tag [31:12] | Index [11:6] | Offset [5:0].</small>

**Block #** = $\left\lfloor\text{Address}/B\right\rfloor$ · **Set Index** = Block # $\bmod S$

**Hex Shortcut · No Full Decimal Conversion**

Line Size = 16 B，Sets = 8，Address Width = 16 bits → **Tag / Index / Offset = 9 / 3 / 4 bits**

`0x123C = 0001 0010 0011 1100₂ = [000100100 | 011 | 1100]₂`

**Tag** = `000100100₂` = `0x24` = 36；**Index** = `011₂` = `0x3` = 3；**Offset** = `1100₂` = `0xC` = 12

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">先按真实位数切字段；转 Hex 时才在左侧补 0 凑足 4 bits：Index 的 011 → 0011，数值不变但 Index 仍是 3 bits；Tag 的 000100100 去除前导 0 只剩 100100（36），不可随意删掉有效位；题目要求 Decimal / Binary / Hex 时按指定格式作答</small>

[Binary ↔ Hex 原理与 4-bit 分组](nodal://note/cis224-midterm-bits-integers-bitwise/sec-binary-hex-5c22cc)


**Example · 2 Sets, 2-way, 16 B/Line**

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">本例每个 Memory Block 对应连续 16 Bytes；B = 16 来自 Line Size，S = 2 来自 Number of Sets；2-way 不参与这一步计算 · 0x 表示十六进制地址</small>

$
\begin{aligned}
A\;(0x00=0):&\quad\left\lfloor 0/16\right\rfloor\bmod 2=0\bmod 2=\boxed{0}\\
B\;(0x20=32):&\quad\left\lfloor 32/16\right\rfloor\bmod 2=2\bmod 2=\boxed{0}\\
C\;(0x40=64):&\quad\left\lfloor 64/16\right\rfloor\bmod 2=4\bmod 2=\boxed{0}
\end{aligned}
$

**A / B / C → Set 0** · Index 选 Set；Tag 匹配 Block；Offset 选 Line 内 Byte

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">交互示例使用相同 B = 16、S = 2（但为 4-way）：A–E 的 Block # 是 0、2、4、6、8 → Set 0；F–I 是 1、3、5、7 → Set 1 · 字母只是 Block 标签，并非 ASCII 地址</small>
